metadata.description: Reusable Claude skills for creators, podcasters and operators: writing, video, podcast, Notion ops and analytics.

plugins.name: creator-core
plugins.description: Shared creator profile (brand, voice, accounts, exclusions) that every other skill reads, plus a step-by-step how-to coach for beginners.

plugins.name: creator-writing
plugins.description: Newsletter essays, Medium adaptations, LinkedIn and X posts, LinkedIn engagement and profile audits, outreach and consulting sales.

plugins.name: creator-video
plugins.description: Instagram and Threads, YouTube packaging, talking-head reel editing, fact-checked explainer reels, documentary-style edits, watching videos and pulling timestamped transcript moments.

plugins.name: creator-podcast
plugins.description: Podcast guest prep and one-episode-to-everything release packages.

plugins.name: creator-notion-ops
plugins.description: Notion content calendar, designer briefs, second-brain logging, research cards and a daily content run that ties it all together.

plugins.name: data-analytics
plugins.description: Funnel, journey, identity-resolution and sessionization patterns in SQL and Tableau, with strict confidentiality rules.
